text:
alex: quick heads-up — prepping per-customer flag for AcmeCorp (enterprise). need a quick ops checklist before we flip canary.

tanvi: thanks. are we doing contract-gated allowlist + vip bypass?

alex: yes. plan: 1) allowlist contract id 9876 only; 2) 5% canary on VIP tenant traffic (only read paths); 3) fallback to "standard-model" on errors; 4) audit logs + alerting.

ben: pinging infra — do we have runtime support for tenant-scoped flags + rollout percent?

infra-bot: infra-check: tenant-scoped flags supported. rollout percent uses the hashing key tenant_id by default. will log decision_id to /var/log/flags.

samira: can we see the exact flag payload format? small snippet helps QA.

alex: putting the config we discussed below — keep in mind values are pseudo config for the ops runbook:

```
{
  "flag_name": "enterprise_feature_x",
  "scope": { "type": "tenant", "tenant_id": "acme-9876" },
  "rollout": { "type": "percent", "value": 5, "hash_key": "tenant_id" },
  "vip_bypass": { "enabled": true, "tenants": ["acme-9876-vip"] },
  "fallback": "standard-model",
  "auditing": "enabled"
}
```

alex: we'll create the flag in staging first then a narrow canary. tagging @tanvi to own QA prompts.

tanvi: got it — I'll write the smoke prompts. quick Q: do we allow admin UI override for VIP bypass?

ben: we do, but restrict to @ops lead role. admin UI changes require a two-person approval for enterprise flags.

samira: also recommend metric alerts: error rate > 0.5% on generation endpoints, latency p95 spike > 250ms, and quality regression on eval prompts > 3 pts.

alex: good catches. adding to checklist. also need DB migration to store contract_id -> tenant mapping for flag evaluation.

ben: DB migration looks small, one table: tenant_contracts(contract_id, tenant_id, tier). i'll open PR and ping for review.

alex: nice. ops rollout plan draft:
- create flag in staging (scoped to acme-9876), validate audit logs
- deploy canary 5% read-only for 2 hours, monitor alerts
- if green, increase to 25% for 24 hours (reads + writes)
- if green, promote to 100% and add ACL for vip bypass
- post-rollout: run eval suite and collect cost delta

samira: note: for contract gating we should also check entitlement expiry. make sure stale contracts don't get enabled.

tanvi: added tests: `test_flag_scope`, `test_vip_bypass`, `test_contract_expires`. i'll push them after ben's PR is up.

ben: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/flags/pull/324 — reviewers: @alex @tanvi. brief diff in flag-eval logic.

alex: reviewing now. small nit in hash function, but infra-bot will validate determinism in canary.

infra-bot: scheduled verification job: flag-hash-consistency for 200 samples across regions. results in 20m.

samira: can someone add a short note to the runbook about emergency rollback steps (disable flag + route to fallback)?

alex: done — runbook updated and linked in PR description.

tanvi: thanks. I'll start QA tomorrow and post results here. :thumbsup:

ben: thanks all — we'll coordinate any hotfixes here.

alex: closing the loop: if nobody objects by EOD I'll proceed with staging creation at 1800Z.

tanvi: no objections from QA.

samira: all good from reliability side.
